page.content:
Third-generation owner who scaled minifigures, Castle, Space, and licensed themes.

How Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen connects

  • Faction: The LEGO Group — Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen led The LEGO Group through the minifigure and license eras.
  • Item: Minifigure — Kjeld's era is when the minifigure and classic themes scaled worldwide.

What is Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen?

Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen led The LEGO Group through the minifigure era, the 1980s theme explosion, and the later recovery that brought Bionicle, Star Wars, and The LEGO Movie.

Key threads lead to The LEGO Group and Minifigure.
